text:
Sean Gallagher: 🚨 Paging incident opened: elevated 5xx + p95 latency spike on `chat-completions` (us-east-1). Impact looks customer-facing for a subset. Threading here. IC: @Rafael Mendes

Rafael Mendes: ack. I’m IC. @Aisha Bello can you grab comms / timeline notes? @Miles Thornton can you sanity check multi-region (is it isolated to us-east-1)?

Aisha Bello: on it. Starting timeline doc + checking alert annotations.

Miles Thornton: looking. Quick glance: eu-west-1 looks fine, us-west-2 slightly noisy but within SLO. us-east-1 is the outlier.

Jacob Stein: incident-bot should drop a context bundle in a sec (new collectors are on for #incidents).

incident-bot: Context bundle (INC-2743) — window: last 60m (generated in 8.4s)

1) Suspected change (heuristic)
• Routing/config change overlaps start of degradation window (Δ at ~18:55 UTC)
  - Service: `inference-router`
  - Region: us-east-1
  - Change type: routing policy bundle update
  - Confidence: medium (time overlap + affected route matches)

2) Recent deploys (per service/region, last 2)
• `inference-router` us-east-1
  - No deploys in last 90m
• `gateway-api` us-east-1
  - 18:12 UTC — v2.41.7 (canary completed) <https://github.com/redwood/gateway/pull/18411|PR#18411>

3) Config diffs (effective config: t-30m → now)
• Source: config-snapshot `routing-policy/effective` (region-aware)
• `routing.policy.bundle_version`
  - was: `2024-02-17T18:10:03Z#b7c2a9f`
  - now: `2024-02-17T18:54:41Z#c1d0e6a`
  - link: <https://console.redwoodinference.com/platform/routing/policies?region=us-east-1&diff=b7c2a9f..c1d0e6a|policy diff>

• `routes./v1/chat_completions.backends`
  - `gpu-pool-east-1a` weight: 80 → 95
  - `gpu-pool-east-1c` weight: 20 → 5

• `overload.shed_mode` unchanged (value: `token_budget_soft`)
• Redaction note: 3 keys omitted (classified sensitive)

4) Saturation snapshot (last 5m)
• GPU util: 62% avg (not saturated)
• Scheduler contention: low
• Queue depth: spiky (p95 48 → 210) on `gpu-pool-east-1a`
• Throttling (429) rate: elevated on `east-1a` only
Dashboard: <https://dash.redwoodinference.com/d/saturation?region=us-east-1&pool=east-1a|Saturation (us-east-1a)>

5) Quick links
• Incident dashboard: <https://dash.redwoodinference.com/d/incidents/INC-2743|INC-2743 overview>
• Router errors by route/model: <https://dash.redwoodinference.com/d/router-errors?region=us-east-1|router errors>

Collector status
✓ deploy_collector ✓ config_diff_collector ✓ saturation_collector

Rafael Mendes: this is super helpful. No deploys, but config diff is loud. Degradation started ~18:56 so timing matches.

Miles Thornton: +1. The queue depth spike being isolated to east-1a lines up with weight going 80→95.

Sean Gallagher: who pushed that routing bundle? @Priya Natarajan / @Ethan Park do you recognize `c1d0e6a`?

deploy-bot: Config change event
• Service: inference-router
• Region: us-east-1
• Bundle: routing-policy
• Version: 2024-02-17T18:54:41Z#c1d0e6a
• Author: Benji Okafor
• Change link: <https://github.com/redwood/routing-config/commit/c1d0e6a|commit c1d0e6a>

Benji Okafor: that was me 😬. I adjusted weights to drain east-1c briefly (node maintenance) but I guess east-1a can’t take 95% right now.

Ethan Park: yep, east-1a has less headroom since we moved a batch workload earlier. We normally cap single-AZ weight at 85 for this route.

Priya Natarajan: rollback path is straightforward: revert bundle to `b7c2a9f` (18:10Z). Benji, can you do it or want SRE to drive?

Rafael Mendes: Benji please revert if you’re comfortable. Otherwise I can. Goal: restore weights to 80/20 or whatever the last known-good was.

Benji Okafor: I can revert. Doing `routingctl apply --region us-east-1 --bundle routing-policy --version 2024-02-17T18:10:03Z#b7c2a9f`. Will post when complete.

Aisha Bello: noting: start time 18:56, suspected config change at 18:54 per bot. Impact: elevated 5xx + 429s on /v1/chat_completions us-east-1. Mitigation in progress = rollback routing policy.

Sean Gallagher: heads up: customer support already pinged on 429s in east. We should see relief fast if this is it.

Benji Okafor: rollback applied. Confirmed effective version now shows `b7c2a9f`. (Took ~25s.)

Miles Thornton: watching graphs… queue depth on east-1a dropping already. 5xx trending down.

Rafael Mendes: nice. Let’s keep monitoring for 10 min. If stable, we can resolve.

incident-bot: Update (auto)
• Detected config rollback: routing.policy.bundle_version `c1d0e6a` → `b7c2a9f` (us-east-1)
• Post-rollback (last 2m):
  - 5xx rate: down 68%
  - p95 latency: 4.2s → 1.6s
  - 429s (east-1a): down 74%

Aisha Bello: wow ok that’s clean. Adding to timeline. Also: bot callout was correct + immediately actionable.

Sean Gallagher: agreed — this is the exact “first 2 minutes” value we’ve been missing. Marking as useful feedback.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: to incident-bot output. We should capture this as a validation case for ENG-2843/2844.

Jacob Stein: awesome. I’ll drop a note in the project thread + tag this incident as “bot_useful=true”.

Priya Natarajan: also a good reminder: need guardrail in policy tooling to enforce max per-AZ weight for critical routes.

Ethan Park: +1. I’ll open a follow-up task to encode that constraint (or at least warn).

Miles Thornton: us-west-2 never moved, so seems isolated to east policy. Everything else looks normal now.

Rafael Mendes: ok, declaring mitigated at 19:16 UTC. Keeping incident open for another few mins to confirm no rebound.

Aisha Bello: comms updated in status thread: “rollback of routing policy in us-east-1; metrics recovering.”

Sean Gallagher: thanks all. Also: bot’s “Redaction note: keys omitted” is good — keeps us from guessing if it failed silently.

Benji Okafor: sorry again. Appreciate fast catch + rollback guidance. The bot basically pointed right at my change.

Rafael Mendes: no worries, that’s why we’re building this. If stable for 5 more mins I’ll close + link this thread in the postmortem notes.

incident-bot: Feedback prompt
Was this context bundle useful? Reply with one of: `useful`, `not useful`, `noisy`, `missing` (+ optional note)

Aisha Bello: useful — config diff + suspected change was spot on. Helped us decide rollback vs chasing saturation.

Sean Gallagher: useful — especially the per-route backend weight diff + region/AZ specificity.

Rafael Mendes: useful. Only ask: include “previous known-good” label when we have it (if safe).

Jacob Stein: logged. Will file this against the collectors improvements list.

Rafael Mendes: closing. Great work.
